framework_lessons: Separate market prices from legal access.
assessment: The explicit China-through-2024 call failed, as did the remaining-2022 gold-over-copper proxy and the proposed relative stickiness of oil. The GBTC conversion condition resolved favorably, with discount risk candidly acknowledged. Crypto counterparty analysis was useful, but the apparent FTX rescue backstop was itself unsound and Bitcoin-only business quality was overstated. Emerging-market, reserve and jurisdiction views are preserved with their actual horizons and triggers. The report acknowledges prior Chinese and dollar timing errors rather than silently resetting them.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
